features.feature: Reproduction test: a test that drives the INIT_CHECK reconcile against a divergent main (story-branch phase INIT, main phase INIT_CHECK) and asserts no conflict markers end up committed in index.json
Test must fail before the fix (markers committed) and pass after (clean post-advance index.json)

Conflict-safe deterministic metadata resolution in commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain: on a conflicted merge of story-metadata, resolve all conflicted paths to the post-advance (main) state — never commit markers
Alternative: if deterministic resolution is not used, detect the conflict, abort the merge (git merge --abort / reset), and surface a clear recovery command instead of leaving markers
Story metadata files must never have conflict markers left or committed after the reconcile
Wrap the main metadata commit + merge step in withReentrantMainWriteLock so a concurrent session cannot move main between the commit and the merge

Main write lock must cover the whole critical section (main metadata commit + merge), not just the final write (session-ownership-and-write-leases.md Rule 3: lock scope must cover the whole critical section)
Lock acquisition failure is blocking — must not proceed optimistically (session-ownership-and-write-leases.md Rule 6)
Reentrant lock variant must be used (the reconcile may run within an already-locked context, e.g. inside a DONE flow)
Lock must be released even if the reconcile throws (no stuck lock)
Scope strictly to INIT_CHECK reconcile; do not rework unrelated phase transitions
Single-session reconcile (no main divergence) must produce byte-identical metadata to today — no regression
Multi-file metadata conflict (multiple paths under storyDir conflicted simultaneously) must be fully resolved deterministically
Concurrent story_advance INIT_CHECK from multiple sessions must be serialized (no corruption from race)
doctor stuck-lock check must remain valid after this change (lock primitive behavior unchanged)
features.excluded_by: Description explicitly scopes only to INIT_CHECK reconcile merge conflict handling; doctor / stuck-lock check is pre-existing and not modified by this story
